context_requirements: Active DNA replication and/or endogenous replication stress (high proliferative fraction)
Functional ATM/ATR–CHK1 signaling axis that can be inhibited
Intact p53 pathway for robust p21/GADD45 induction (p53-mutant lines show weaker transcriptional DDR)
Tumor cells with constitutive DDR activation (e.g., MYC-driven) are more sensitive
falsifiers: No decrease in CDC25A/CDC25B or no increase in CDKN1A/GADD45A at 6 h in any line
No reduction in mitotic genes (CCNB1, CDK1, PLK1, AURKA/B, BIRC5) at 24 h
No evidence of DNA damage response (e.g., no RPA2, TOPBP1, or p53-target induction) at either time
Transcriptional response indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine lines

evidence.supports: XL-844 inhibits Chk1/Chk2, abrogates Chk2 phosphorylation, induces pan-nuclear γ-H2AX and mitotic catastrophe
Prexasertib reduces clonogenic survival, affects cell cycle progression, induces apoptosis and double-stranded DNA breakage
CHK1 inhibition by AZD7762 causes aberrant mitotic entry and augmented γH2AX signaling indicating replication stress
CHK inhibitor PF-0477736/AZD-7762 hinders proliferation and induces rapid DNA damage accumulation and apoptosis in DDR-activated lymphoma
Chk1/Chk2 inhibitors alter apoptin localization, confirming target engagement of checkpoint kinases
